title: Usage
subtitle: Your Claude account's rate-limit standing, captured from the CLI's own /status and /usage panels.

empty.title: No usage captures yet
empty.hint: Click "Capture now" to launch a claude session in the background, read its /status and /usage panels, and save the result here.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.empty: No accounts added yet. Log the CLI into an account with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<dir> claude, then add it here.
accounts.emptyHistory: No captures yet for this account

healthSummary.hint: How many of your accounts are connected (last capture succeeded) vs. need attention (needs login, errored, or never captured).

status.needsLoginHint: Click to open a terminal and log in to this account

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Whether you're actively using each account, inferred from real movement in its own rate-limit percentages between captures.

calendar.title: Weekly reset countdown
calendar.subtitle: How many days until each account's weekly window resets.
calendar.totalRemainingHint: Total remaining percentage across all accounts, added together (100% minus each account's used percentage).

sessionTimeline.title: Session reset times
sessionTimeline.subtitle: What time of day each account's session window resets, over the next 24h.

consumptionRate.title: Consumption rate
consumptionRate.subtitle: Predicted, from each account's recent pace, whether it will run out before its session/weekly window resets.

rotationPlan.title: Rotation plan
rotationPlan.subtitle: Projected order to work through your accounts this week, based on each one's current weekly burn rate.
rotationPlan.notEnoughData: Not enough weekly data yet to project a rotation.

colorThresholds.title: Configuration
colorThresholds.subtitle: Configure where the green → yellow → orange → red usage colors switch over, applied across this page, plus the Rotation Plan's account-handoff threshold.
colorThresholds.rateScopeDescription: Measured as a multiple of sustainable pace, not a percentage — 1.0 means burning exactly fast enough to hit 100% right at reset. Typically set between 0.5 and 1.5.
colorThresholds.rotationSwitchDescription: Percentage of the weekly window at which the Rotation Plan hands off to the next account — leaving this much headroom unspent on the outgoing one instead of running it to 100%.
colorThresholds.rotationSwitchSummary: Hands off at {{switchPct}}% — leaving {{reservePct}}% of the weekly window in reserve.
colorThresholds.validationError: Each threshold must be higher than the last (yellow < orange < red).
